notes: Official maserati.com/au spec pages returned only navigation elements (driveaway price calculator, stock locator, dealer finder) with no numeric spec table content retrievable, so battery capacity, range, torque, 0-100 time, AC/DC charge rates and seat count could NOT be confirmed for either model and are left null rather than guessed -- this is the largest data gap of any brand researched. GranTurismo Folgore pricing is confusing across sources: CarExpert's 2026 pricing-history table shows drive-away prices of $395,753-$474,618 for '2024' model-year cars, while a separate 2025-launch article and a dedicated spec page both cite '$450,000' as the 'before on-road costs' base price; $450,000 is used here as the MSRP figure since it is explicitly described as a before-on-road-costs base price, but the drive-away table figures should not be assumed equivalent. Grecale Folgore drive-away price citations were inconsistent ($122,763-$226,493 across different CarExpert table rows); the $207,500 before-on-road-costs figure is used as it was the only figure explicitly described as a base 'before on-road costs' price.
